notes: Predates the window (baseline: the current Haiku until Haiku 5.5). Page: 'Pricing is now $1/$5'. Snapshot id dated 2025-10-01, 14 days before launch. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2025-10-15 (same day).

Page: 'Pricing is now $5/$25' (a cut from earlier Opus pricing). Snapshot id dated 2025-11-01, 23 days before public launch; the last dated Opus id. Release notes 2025-11-24 confirm. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2025-11-24 (same day).

First dateless (pinned) API id. 'Pricing remains the same at $5/$25'; 1M context in beta with >200k-token prompts at $10/$37.50. Release notes 2026-02-05 confirm. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2026-02-04, one day before the official date (OpenRouter slug says 20260205).

'Pricing remains the same as Sonnet 4.5, starting at $3/$15'. Release notes 2026-02-17 confirm. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2026-02-17 (same day).

Gated, invitation-only research preview for defensive cybersecurity (Project Glasswing), not generally available; not on OpenRouter. Glasswing page: after the $100M usage credits, '$25/$125 per million input/output tokens'. Release notes 2026-04-07 confirm; Frontier Red Team post published 2026-04-07 (anthropic.com/research/mythos-preview). Deprecated 2026-06-09, retirement TBA.

'Pricing remains the same as Opus 4.6: $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens'. Introduces a new tokenizer producing roughly 30% more tokens for the same text (docs), so per-token prices are not comparable across this boundary. Release notes 2026-04-16 confirm. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2026-04-16 (same day).

'unchanged from Opus 4.7: $5 ... $25'; fast mode $10/$50. Release notes 2026-05-28 confirm. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2026-05-27, one day before the official date (OpenRouter slug says 20260528).

New top tier, announced jointly with Mythos 5 (same underlying model, stronger safeguards). Access suspended for all users from 2026-06-12 (US export-control directive; https://www.anthropic.com/news/fable-mythos-access) and restored 2026-07-01 (https://www.anthropic.com/news/redeploying-fable-5, release notes 2026-07-01): unavailable ~19 days of its first 22. Cloud partners re-enabled later. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2026-06-09 (same day).

Project Glasswing participants only; same underlying model as Fable 5 with fewer safeguards; 'Pricing for both models is $10 ... $50'. Suspended 2026-06-12; restored for a set of US organizations after US government approval on 2026-06-26 (statement dated 2026-06-30). Not on OpenRouter. Retirement not sooner than 2027-06-09.

$2/$10 was introductory pricing with standard pricing of $3/$15 scheduled from 2026-09-01; on 2026-08-10 the introductory price was made permanent (page changelog; release notes 2026-08-10). New tokenizer (~30% more tokens than pre-4.7 models). Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2026-06-30 (same day).

'priced at $5 ... $25 (the same as Opus 4.8)'. Release notes 2026-07-24 confirm. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2026-07-24 (same day; OpenRouter slug says 20260723).

Day from the dated 2026-09-01 release-notes entry; the announcement page (https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-1) gives only 'September 2026' and 'available today'. Price unchanged from Fable 5 at $10/$50, cache reads cut 75% to $0.25. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2026-09-01 (same day; OpenRouter slug says 20260831).
Launched alongside Fable 5.1 for Project Glasswing participants; release notes: 'Both models ... at $10 / $50 USD per MTok'. Not on OpenRouter. Retirement not sooner than 2027-09-01.

Page dated September 22, 2026: '$4 and $20 per million, 20% less than Opus 5'; cache reads $0.20; fast mode $8/$40. First Opus list-price cut since Opus 4.5. Release notes 2026-09-22 confirm. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2026-09-22 (same day; slug says 20260921).

Page dated September 28, 2026: 'priced the same as Sonnet 5 at $2 ... $10'. Cache reads were $0.20 at launch and cut to $0.10 on 2026-10-07 (release notes; Haiku 5.5 page); the Sonnet 5.5 page now says $0.10, so it appears edited after launch. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2026-09-28 (same day).

Page dated October 7, 2026. First Haiku since 4.5 (no Haiku 5). Tiered pricing: $0.10/$0.50 for prompts up to 100k tokens, $0.50/$2.50 over 100k (the columns hold the lower tier; OpenRouter lists the same); a 90% cut from Haiku 4.5's $1/$5 at the lower tier. Release notes 2026-10-07 confirm. Retirement 'not sooner than' date on the deprecations page is exactly one year after this date (corroborates). OpenRouter added 2026-10-07 (same day).
